chip.description: Road layer generator for Taito driving games: two forkable roads composed per scanline from 256 lines of road RAM (edge and body positions, colour bank, priority) plus road graphics tiles fetched from ROM.
chip.notes: src/mame/taito/tc0150rod.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("Road generator. Two roads allow for forking. Gfx data fetched from ROM"), with the per-line RAM layout including a "Road Gfx Tile number" field. Filed video-tilemap under taxonomy V3 — a scrolling layer generated from a map plus a character ROM into the scanout path — because the taxonomy has no road-generator value; flagged as a judgement call.
